# Support

If you need help with this project, please check out the following resources:

- **Documentation:** Check out our README for usage instructions.
- **Issues:** Search existing issues to see if your problem has already been reported.
- **WordPress.org Support Forum:** Visit [our plugin support forum on WordPress.org](https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/nexura-redirects/) for free community support.

## Premium Support
If you have purchased a premium version or need dedicated support, please contact us via our official website.
